---
title: Vega smoke report
---

Two cells of the project. Each statement with rows takes a run arrow, as in a script.

```{avenger-sql}
--| label: origins
FROM heavy_by_origin
|> AGGREGATE mark_bar(x => Origin, y => cars) AS chart
```

The second cell has two queries: the days of each weather, then their chart.

```{avenger-sql}
FROM wet_days
|> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS days GROUP BY weather;

FROM wet_days
|> AGGREGATE mark_bar(x => weather, y => COUNT(*)) AS chart
```
